entities.name: Methyl 3-cyclododecylpropanoate
observations: Substrate represented as COC(=O)CCC1CCCCCCCCCCC1; contains a methyl ester.
The methyl ester is converted to the corresponding carboxylic acid while the carbon skeleton and cyclododecyl ring remain unchanged.

entities.name: 3-Cyclododecylpropanoic acid
observations: Product represented as O=C(O)CCC1CCCCCCCCCCC1; formed by hydrolysis of the methyl ester.

entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: Net transformation is methyl ester hydrolysis: R-C(=O)-OCH3 becomes R-C(=O)-OH, with methanol or methoxide as the leaving-group-derived fragment.
An exact or near-exact record used NaOH in methanol/water at approximately 55 °C and reported 25.1% yield.

entities.name: NaOH methanol water 55 C
observations: Database-supported conditions for this ester hydrolysis are NaOH in methanol/water at approximately 55 °C, followed by acidic workup to isolate the carboxylic acid.
Reported yield for the matched record was 25.1%.
